limits: Disposable fixtures replace Start and demo_estate, not production files.
Actual next_day bath payload and end_day_screen bath span execute in the installed native engine.
Only diagnostic copies add counters inside the original repulse and bathing dynamic definitions.
display_pic instrumentation records the requested actor/action; distinct per-actor text sentinels check scene identity without copying display prose.
64 room-fallback repetitions require at least two distinct rooms; this detects fixed-order selection but does not statistically prove uniform randomness.
State is primed from save assignments; no actual save load/write or visual image-content validation.
